title: 第8章 第二案：水泥藏尸（1）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“李队，对方刚打来电话说是搞错了，已经撤案了。”

“搞错了？”

“恩，他说是看错了，不是什么人体组织，是块猪皮。

今天工地的食堂师傅特地找卖猪肉的老板要的。

拿回来的时候，不小心掉了一块到水泥里。

他们糊墙的时候看到，差点被吓死。

那皮上还有红印章呢。”

李安国皱眉。

有红印章，应该是猪皮没错。

但他心里总有种怪怪的感觉。

人皮和猪皮还是有区别的吧？

【来了来了，他来了！】

【专杀前女友的大变态！】

【整天疑神疑鬼，一句话不对，就把前女友刀了，还糊在水泥里砌墙！当初看到这个案子，我好几年都没敢谈恋爱。】

【他爸也是个糊涂的，不仅不报案还助纣为虐！】

【我记得这个工地撤案后，过了六年，凶手再次犯案才被抓住。】

【没办法，办案要讲证据，报案人都撤了，建的还是高架桥，谁都不敢耽误。】

【要是这次的案子也能像上次一样圆满结束就好了！】

【坏人就该早点死！】

念念突然听到弹幕声音，愣了几秒。

自从她离开警局，弹幕就消失了。

怎么现在又出现了？

李安国发着信息。

思来想去，还是觉得应该去工地上看看。

警员发来地址。

李安国导航定位后，有些诧异。

这不就是废品收购站拆迁的工地吗？

“念念，我出去一趟，你就在这好好吊水，等会曼妮阿姨会来接你。”

念念乖巧点头。

等药水吊完，拿着李安国留给她的钱，去医院食堂买了一个大馒头。

还要了一杯水和一个塑料袋。

在征求了保洁阿姨的同意后，将食堂桌面上留下的饮料空瓶全都装了起来。

等她忙完回到病房，刚好看到任曼妮在找她。

“念念，你去哪啦？吓死我了！

下次一个人不要乱跑听到没？”

念念挠头，“可我一直都是一个人啊，而且我答应了李叔叔，要捡破烂养他。

他工作已经很累了，我自己一个人可以的！

你看，念念今天又捡了这么多，可以买两个大馒头！

待会路上再捡一捡，今天晚上我和李叔叔的晚饭就有着落了！

说不定还能买一袋小咸菜。”

任曼妮看着念念开心的笑脸，心情复杂。

好一会才说道：“念念，你以后不用捡破烂了。”

任曼妮将李安国的工资，还有可以在单位食堂免费吃饭的事，全都讲给念念听。

目的就是让念念知道。

李安国能养得起她！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Team Li, the other party just called and said there was a mistake and the case has been withdrawn."

"Made a mistake?"

"Well, he said he saw it wrong. It was not human tissue, but a piece of pig skin.

Today, the canteen chef at the construction site specifically asked the pork seller for some.

When I took it back, I accidentally dropped a piece into the cement.

When they were putting up the wall, they were almost frightened to death when they saw it.

There is still a red seal on the skin."

Li Anguo frowned.

It has a red seal, so it must be pig skin.

But there was always a strange feeling in his heart.

There is still a difference between human skin and pig skin, right?

[Coming, coming, he is coming!】

[The pervert who specializes in killing his ex-girlfriend!】

[I was paranoid all day long, and if I said the wrong thing, I would kill my ex-girlfriend, and she would still be stuck in cement to build a wall!When I first saw this case, I didn’t dare to fall in love for several years.】

[His father is also confused. Not only does he not report the crime, he also helps the perpetrators!】

[I remember that after the case was withdrawn at this construction site, it took six years before the murderer was caught again after committing another crime.】

[There is no way, the case requires evidence. The people who reported the case have withdrawn, and the viaduct is still being built. No one dares to delay it.】

[It would be great if this case could end as successfully as last time!】

[The bad guys should die early!】

Niannian suddenly heard the barrage sound and was stunned for a few seconds.

Since she left the police station, the barrage has disappeared.

Why does it appear again now?

Li Anguo sent a message.

After thinking about it, I still think I should go to the construction site and take a look.

The police officer sent the address.

After Li Anguo navigated and positioned himself, he was a little surprised.

Isn't this the demolition site of the scrap collection station?

"Nian Nian, I'll go out for a while, and you can drink water here. Aunt Manni will come to pick you up later."

Nian Nian nodded obediently.

After the potion was finished, she took the money Li Anguo left for her and went to the hospital cafeteria to buy a big steamed bun.

Also asked for a glass of water and a plastic bag.

After asking the cleaning lady for permission, she filled up all the empty drink bottles left on the table in the canteen.

When she finished her work and returned to the ward, she happened to see Ren Manni looking for her.

"Nian Nian, where have you been? You scared me to death!

Next time, don’t run around alone, okay?"

Nian Nian scratched her head, "But I have always been alone, and I promised Uncle Li that I would pick up rags and raise him.

He is already very tired from work, I can do it by myself!

You see, Niannian picked up so many today, she can buy two big steamed buns!

I'll pick it up again on the way later, and Uncle Li and I will have dinner together tonight!

Maybe you can even buy a bag of pickles."

Ren Manni looked at Nian Nian's happy smiling face with mixed emotions.

After a while, he said: "Nian Nian, you don't have to pick up rags anymore."

Ren Manni told Nian Nian everything about Li Anguo's salary and the fact that he could eat for free in the workplace canteen.

The purpose is to let Niannian know.

Li Anguo can afford to support her!
